proposals.mechanism_one_line: Daily event-driven clock: after a policy-rate change first satisfies available_time_utc <= T, hold 10 sessions in the direction of the change (hike long / cut short the affected area's pair side).

proposals.title: Policy-rate differential divergence trend at a weekly clock
